incidents.name: BIGFI reflection-token pair drain
incidents.notes: BIGFI is a reflective deflationary token: deliver() cuts the reflected supply and inflates the liquidity pair's balance without a sync(), so the attacker swapped the inflated balance out for the pair's USDT.

sources.ref: onchain review: BIGFI 0xd3d4B46Db01C006Fb165879f343fc13174a1cEeB created 2023-03-07T21:16:44Z by 0x602546d439ea254f3372c3985840750c6b9c6ddb, unrelated to attack sender 0x76a88c2baebf251701435abbe8af11ad52b0ab04; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 30,466.10 USDT left the BIGFI/USDT pair and 30,306.10 USDT reached the attack contract.
